conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: The job is to change the session timeout and be confident it took effect. In A I reproduced the full path: selecting 12 hours shows a role=status unsaved bar, saving updates the panel value, the header summary ('SESSION TIMEOUT 12 hours'), and announces 'Session timeout updated to 12 hours. Applies after each member's next sign-in.' via aria-live=polite, and the value survives navigating to other sections. In B the same path leaves the panel reading 'Currently 30 days' after Save changes, because that string is hardcoded to the FACTS constant (source/app.js:393), and the success toast is not a live region — so the administrator gets no truthful confirmation of the one change they came to make. B is better on breadth and honesty (all 23 actions explicitly labelled, empty tables stated as 'no data in this preview'), and A loses points for inventing member identities and token records, but that does not block the task the way B's stale post-save state misleads it.
suspected_unblinding: none that identifies a treatment. B does surface eval scaffolding in the product UI (a 'YOUR TASK' badge on the session-timeout card and a 'Jump to session timeout' header link), which reveals the brief framing but says nothing about which team built it.

findings.label: B
findings.description: After saving the new session timeout the panel still states 'Currently 30 days', so the administrator cannot confirm the policy change actually applied.
findings.evidence: Reproduced locally (Playwright, chromium, 1440x900): selected '12 hours', clicked 'Save changes', unsaved bar cleared, but main text still read 'Currently 30 days. Reversible; applies after a member's next sign-in.'; cause visible in source/app.js:393 where the description interpolates FACTS.sessionTimeout instead of state.

findings.label: B
findings.description: No accessible confirmation of the save, and the destructive dialog cannot be dismissed with Escape and loses focus on cancel.
findings.evidence: Reproduced: after save, zero elements matching [aria-live],[role=status],[role=alert] contained text (only the save bar carries role=status, source/app.js:520; the success toast has none). In the delete dialog, Escape left it open and Cancel returned focus to <body>; Tab left the dialog on the second press despite aria-modal=true.
